summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (JTM 5.1/39)

data.turoyo: omər mar oġlum, məs səmlux? məstaʕrəf biya gənnaḥlux! <...>
data.translation: Er sagte: Sag, mein Junge, was hast du getan? Gestehe es, dann wirst du genesen. <...>

rationale: New Imperativ box; clear direct command with anaphoric b-content.

data.turoyo: <...> d məstaʕrəf bu kewayḏe, u mede d səmle gənnaḥle, w d lo, nyoḥo layto.
data.translation: <...> Wenn er (den Grund für) seine Krankheit bekennt, das was er getan hat, wird er genesen, andernfalls gibt es keine Genesung.

rationale: Thin Infectum/1 cell; explicit b-content and conditional consequence.

data.turoyo: <...> omər məs səmlux, mən ḥṭiṯo kətwolux, qay lə kməstaʕrəfət biya d naḥlux? <...>
data.translation: <...> Er sagte: Was hast du getan? Welche Sünde hast du begangen? Warum willst du sie nicht gestehen, damit du gesund wirst? <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum/1; second-person negated question supplies a clear antecedent for biya.

data.translation: <...> Er sagte: Was soll ich denn gestehen? <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum/1; unusual first-person deliberative form in the confession exchange.

summary: The contact-derived məstaʕrəf forms remain I, as in the inherited entry; internal t- does not justify reclassification as Detransitive. The direct exhortation məstaʕrəf biya in JTM 5.1/39 supplies a new Imperativ box, though its surface coincides with the unprefixed Infectum base.
Infectum morphology contrasts unprefixed conditional, k-prefixed second person and g-prefixed first-person deliberation; person and modal context do not create new senses.
PrS 77/67 is already quoted in the inherited Infectum cell, despite its different reference. Confession is a cover story in the scene; irony does not give the verb a sexual meaning.
Confirm Imperativ məstaʕrəf versus an exhortative unprefixed Infectum at JTM 5.1/39; the preceding directive mar and second-person address support the current Imperativ filing.
Reconcile supplied PrS 77/67 with inherited prs 226/34. Do not replace the inherited citation without checking the numbering systems.

b- marks the confessed matter (wrongdoing, referred to by biya); taḥt iḏi identifies the confessor's authority in the inherited example. Ordinary confession of wrongdoing remains sense 1 without a new secular versus sacramental split.
